description: This file defines the SQSAdapter class, which implements the IQueueAdapter interface for integrating AWS SQS with Orleans streams. It provides functionalities such as creating receivers and queuing message batches to SQS, with internal management of queues and serialization.

classes.name: SQSAdapter
classes.description: Implements an Orleans stream queue adapter for AWS SQS, managing queuing, serialization, and queue connections.

methods.name: SQSAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the SQSAdapter with serializers, queue mapper, logger factory, connection string, service ID, and provider name.

methods.name: CreateReceiver
methods.description: Creates and returns a new SQSAdapterReceiver for a specified QueueId.

methods.name: QueueMessageBatchAsync
methods.description: Queues a batch of messages to SQS for a specific stream, ensuring the correct queue is used and serializing messages appropriately.
